from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792544931/attempts/5b17e8f43661473aad6b536871505fc9/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6c9b01ad.py')
p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Uniform non-background lines are the tile separators.
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]
    # Select separator color(s); the background is the most common cell color.
    from collections import Counter
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    rows = [r for r in rows if grid[r][0] != bg]
    cols = [c for c in cols if grid[0][c] != bg]
    rbounds = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cbounds = [-1] + cols + [w]
    rowspans = [(rbounds[i] + 1, rbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(rbounds)-1)]
    colspans = [(cbounds[i] + 1, cbounds[i+1]) for i in range(len(cbounds)-1)]
    # Gather every visible part of the motif by its within-tile position.
    motif = {}
    for r0, r1 in rowspans:
        for c0, c1 in colspans:
            for r in range(r0, r1):
                for c in range(c0, c1):
                    if grid[r][c] != bg:
                        motif[(r-r0, c-c0)] = grid[r][c]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r0, r1 in rowspans:
        for c0, c1 in colspans:
            for (dr, dc), value in motif.items():
                if r0 + dr < r1 and c0 + dc < c1:
                    out[r0+dr][c0+dc] = value
    return out
'''
p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code,str(p),'exec'),globals())
